fields.label: Expiry Return Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse where Expiry-return goods are placed. Item warehouses are set here and rates halved automatically when Return Reason = Expiry.

fields.label: Damaged Return Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse where Damaged-return goods are placed. Item warehouses are set here automatically when Return Reason = Damaged (rates are not changed).

fields.label: Auto Submit
fields.description: The Sales Pro app creates these as drafts and never comes back to submit them. Turn a document on here and it is submitted the moment it is created. A submitted document can no longer be edited — only cancelled and amended — so leave a document off if anyone corrects it before submitting.

Off: orders arrive as drafts. From the App Only: orders from Sales Pro are submitted on arrival, while orders typed in the desk stay drafts. App and Desk: everything is submitted on creation. Submitting also pushes the order to SAP when Send Sales Orders is set to On Submit.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Sales Orders
fields.options:
Off
From the App Only
App and Desk

fields.description: Same, for van stock requests. Submitting one sends it to SAP as an Inventory Transfer Request straight away, so a request with a missing or unmapped warehouse will submit and then fail its SAP push. Van returns are left alone unless the box opposite is ticked.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Material Requests
fields.options:
Off
From the App Only
App and Desk

fields.depends_on: eval:['From the App Only', 'App and Desk'].includes(doc.auto_submit_sales_orders) || ['From the App Only', 'App and Desk'].includes(doc.auto_submit_material_requests)
fields.description: Leave OFF. The document is then submitted a moment later, in the background, so the salesman's phone is not left waiting on the SAP call that submitting triggers (SAP is given 25 seconds to answer). Tick it only if the desk must show the document as submitted the instant it is saved — that adds SAP's response time to every save.
fields.label: Submit In the Same Request

fields.description: Van returns are left as drafts because the app creates them that way on purpose, and the permanent-return flow expects a manager to approve them first. Tick this only if returns should be submitted on arrival too.
fields.label: Also Auto-Submit Van Returns
